provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A JSON response carries no charset parameter by definition, so it must not be reported as a charset-less Content-Type (the old directive check fired on every media type).

groundTruth.rationale: RFC 8259 defines JSON as UTF-8 and forbids adding a charset parameter, so its absence is correct configuration, not a weakened control. The rule is scoped to text/html and text/plain.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live API call.
The case pins media-type scoping, not the encoding of any real response body.
